sumInsured: Not specified in provided extract (Schedule of Benefits/Policy Schedule will specify Benefit-wise Sum Insured; illustration shows examples like ₹3,00,000)

great.name: PED Waiting
great.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
great.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 24 months from the start of coverage. This 24-month waiting period is better than many plans that have longer waits of 36 to 48 months.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered during the first 30 days except for accidents. This 30-day initial waiting period is standard in health insurance.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.reference: Section 4.1(i)(b) Specific waiting period – code – Excl02
good.explanation: Certain listed diseases and treatments are excluded for 24 months from policy start. This 24-month waiting period is industry standard.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: The Company will indemnify the Medical Expenses up to the amount specified against this Benefit in the Schedule of Benefits... As Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses immediately prior... As Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses immediately following... provided that the Company shall not be liable... for any Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses that were incurred 30 days or more after the Policy End Date
good.explanation: Pre- and post-hospitalization expenses are covered with durations defined in the Schedule of Benefits. Post-hospitalization bills up to 30 days after policy end may also be considered.

good.name: Restore Benefit
good.quote: Benefit 7 : Recharge of Sum Insured... The Recharge shall be available only for all future Claims and not in relation to any Illness or Injury for which a Claim has already been admitted for that Insured Person during that Policy Year.
good.explanation: The policy offers a restore benefit that recharges sum insured for new illnesses or injuries after the base sum insured is exhausted. It cannot be used for the same illness already claimed in that policy year.

good.name: Consumables
good.quote: Benefit 2 : Consumable Allowance... The Company will pay the amount specified against this Benefit in the Schedule of Benefits for each continuous and completed period of 24 hours of Hospitalization
good.explanation: A fixed allowance for consumables is paid per 24 hours of hospitalization. This reduces out-of-pocket costs but may not cover all actual consumable expenses.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: Room Rent = 1% of Benefit 1 Sum Insured as specified in the Schedule of Benefits per day of Hospitalization.
bad.explanation: Room rent is capped at 1% of sum insured per day, not at actuals. This cap can cause significant out-of-pocket expenses in higher-cost hospitals.

bad.name: Proportionate Deduction
bad.quote: then the Policyholder/ Insured Person shall bear the ratable proportion of the total Associate Medical Expenses... in the proportion of the difference between the Room Rent actually incurred and the Room Rent specified in the Policy Schedule
bad.explanation: If you choose a room above the eligible limit, not only room rent but also related medical expenses are reduced proportionately. This can greatly reduce claim payouts.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-payment is applicable on all the Benefits / Optional Covers except Benefit 2, Benefit 3, Benefit 5, Benefit 7, Benefit 9, Optional Cover 2 & Optional Cover 3.
bad.reference: Section 3. Benefits Covered Under The Policy – General Conditions applicable to all Benefits, clause (f)
bad.explanation: Co-payment applies mandatorily on most benefits except a few. The actual co-pay percentage is in the schedule and can significantly reduce claim amounts.

bad.name: Co-pay Loading
bad.quote: The applicable Co-payment will increase by 10% per Claim in the Policy Year following the Insured Person... attaining Age 71... option to waive... upon payment of extra premium
bad.explanation: After age 71, co-pay increases by 10% per claim unless extra premium is paid. This raises out-of-pocket costs for seniors.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: The Company will indemnify... in respect of the below mentioned Ailments / Procedures up to the amount specified against each and every Ailment / Procedure mentioned in the Policy Schedule
bad.reference: Section 3.1.1(c)(iii) Expenses incurred on treatment for Named Ailments / Procedures
bad.explanation: The policy imposes rupee sub-limits on specific diseases and procedures, which can sharply limit payouts even if the overall sum insured is high.

bad.name: Modern Treatments
bad.quote: Expenses related to any kind of Advance Technology Methods other than mentioned in the Clause 3.1.1 (d).
bad.explanation: Only certain advanced treatments listed in the policy are covered; others are excluded. This restricts access to newer medical procedures.

bad.name: Consumables Exclusions
bad.quote: Annexure II - List of Expenses Generally Excluded ("Non-medical")... Gloves... Mask... Nebulisation Kit... Any Kit With No Details Mentioned
bad.reference: Annexure II - List of Expenses Generally Excluded (Non-medical)
bad.explanation: Many commonly billed consumables are excluded as non-medical items, increasing out-of-pocket expenses since only a limited allowance is provided.

unclear.name: NCB
unclear.quote: Cumulative Bonus shall mean any increase in the Sum Insured granted by the insurer without an associated increase in premium.
unclear.explanation: The policy defines cumulative bonus but does not clarify the bonus rate or whether it resets to zero after a claim. This information should be confirmed from the policy schedule.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
